methodology.name: Exam-informed, evidence-based English conversation tracking
methodology.status: Retrospective evidence audit completed through Session 12; current evidence updated through Session 15 on 2026-09-25
methodology.disclaimer: This is a personal learning record based on Daily Notes and transcript excerpts, not a standardized English proficiency test.
methodology.comparison_rule: Change the core L1-L5 level only when the recorded evidence supports the full rubric threshold. Retrospective within-level stages may show cautious progress inside the same L band, but they are not standardized scores and task-condition differences must remain explicit.
design_references: TOEIC: combine a level descriptor with an abilities-measured breakdown
IELTS Speaking: separate fluency and coherence, lexical resource, grammatical range and accuracy, and pronunciation
TOEFL iBT Speaking: consider delivery, language use, and topic development
Cambridge English Speaking: consider grammar and vocabulary, discourse management, pronunciation, interactive communication, and global achievement
CEFR and ACTFL: use observable can-do-style descriptions of effective real-life language use

Task achievement.1: 語や短句が中心で、課題を進めるには継続的な促しが必要。
Task achievement.2: 簡単な質問には答えられるが、理由や例には頻繁な支援が必要。
Task achievement.3: 身近な話題で結論と理由を伝え、支援があれば例やまとめも加えられる。
Task achievement.4: 結論・理由・例・まとめを自力で完結できる。
Task achievement.5: 複雑・未知の話題でも目的に合わせて柔軟かつ詳しく展開できる。

Fluency & coherence.1: 長い停止が多く、発話の継続に強い支援が必要。
Fluency & coherence.2: 短い句で話し、停止・繰り返し・言い直しが頻繁。
Fluency & coherence.3: 詰まりや言い直しがあっても、意味のつながりを保って話を続けられる。
Fluency & coherence.4: 小さなためらいで、一貫したまとまりのある発話を継続できる。
Fluency & coherence.5: 複雑な内容でも自然なペースと構成で柔軟に話せる。

Lexical resource.1: ごく基本的な単語・定型句に限られる。
Lexical resource.2: 身近な語彙は使えるが、語探しが多く支援を要する。
Lexical resource.3: 身近な話題に必要な語彙を使い、確認・言い換えで意図を伝えられる。
Lexical resource.4: 幅のある語彙を文脈に合わせて選び、柔軟に言い換えられる。
Lexical resource.5: 微妙な意味差や自然な連語を含め、正確かつ柔軟に語彙を運用できる。

Grammar control.1: 語や断片が中心で、誤りにより意味が不明瞭になりやすい。
Grammar control.2: 単純な文型を使えるが、誤りの理解に支援が必要なことが多い。
Grammar control.3: 単純な文と一部の複雑な文を使い、誤りがあっても意味は明確。
Grammar control.4: 複数の文型を使い、伝達を妨げる誤りが少ない。
Grammar control.5: 幅広い文型を柔軟かつ高い正確さで使える。

Interaction & repair.1: 相手の促しに強く依存し、確認や言い直しが難しい。
Interaction & repair.2: 応答はできるが、自発的な展開や修復には支援が必要。
Interaction & repair.3: 意味を確認し、支援があれば言い直しや会話の継続ができる。
Interaction & repair.4: 自発的に質問・確認・言い直しを行い、話題を展開できる。
Interaction & repair.5: 相手に合わせてターンを調整し、含意や微妙なずれも柔軟に修復できる。

Pronunciation.1: 理解が難しい箇所が多く、頻繁な聞き返し・反復が必要。
Pronunciation.2: 身近な語句は理解可能だが、音・強勢・リズムに継続的な支援が必要。
Pronunciation.3: 概ね理解可能だが、強勢・リズム・つながりが時折理解を妨げる。
Pronunciation.4: 意味チャンク・強勢・つながりが安定し、軽微な問題だけが残る。
Pronunciation.5: 複雑な発話でも明瞭で自然な韻律を一貫して使える。

within_level_stage_scale.purpose: Show evidence-supported progress inside an unchanged L1-L5 band without claiming an unsupported full-level increase.
within_level_stage_scale.emerging: The behavior is present but still inconsistent or support-dependent within the stated L band.
within_level_stage_scale.established: The behavior is repeatedly visible and stable within the stated L band.
within_level_stage_scale.strong: The behavior is near the upper part of the stated L band, while the next full rubric threshold is not yet consistently met.
within_level_stage_scale.pronunciation_boundary: Assign a pronunciation stage only when direct audio was assessed. Different passages are not treated as comparable improvement evidence.

sessions.evidence_quote: In short time, plasma behaves as particle. But in long term, the plasma behaves as a fluid.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Spontaneous explanation in the realtime transcript
sessions.evidence_note_ja: 応募先のエネルギー企業の脱炭素方針、電化と発電時CO2のトレードオフ、先端エネルギー研究で使う複数スケールのシミュレーションと実験設計を、自分の研究経験と社会的な動機へ結び付けて詳しく説明した。専門語を確認しながら意味を保ち、訂正が多すぎることも自発的に指摘して会話方針を修復した。共通60秒課題は未実施のため定量値は追加せず、発音は直接音声を計測していないためN/Aとする。
sessions.evidence_note: Explained a target energy company's decarbonization strategy, the trade-off between electrification and power-generation emissions, and multiscale simulation and experimental design in advanced-energy research, connecting research experience to societal motivation. Preserved meaning while checking technical vocabulary and independently repaired the conversation when feedback became excessive. No comparable 60-second task was used, so no quantitative values are added; pronunciation is N/A because audio was not directly measured.

sessions.task_ja: AIデータセンター・電力インフラ・マイクログリッドの議論

sessions.evidence_note: Connected AI data-centre demand, grids, microgrids, primary energy, and the difference between electrification and decarbonisation to a personal viewpoint. A direct one-minute recording was intelligible throughout and showed no clipping. Pronunciation is recorded conservatively at L3 for overall intelligibility; this is not a standardized phonetic score.

sessions.task_ja: キャリア選択と最終面接準備
sessions.data_coverage: Realtime transcript excerpts; no comparable 60-second benchmark and no reliable direct audio analysis
sessions.evidence_quote: I’m keeping both options open until I have enough information.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Session conclusion, formulated after a spontaneous career discussion in the realtime transcript
sessions.evidence_note_ja: 社内異動、外部選考、過去の職場経験、長期キャリアへの希望を結び付け、情報がそろってから冷静に決めるという結論を作った。感情的に難しい背景を話す間にhesitation、restart、断片的な文、時制・語順の不安定さはあったが、必要な語や意図を確認し、主要な意図を明確に保ちながら相談を進めた。感情負荷の高い一回の会話を能力低下と扱わず、既存のL3を維持する。共通60秒課題は未実施で、発音を直接評価できる新規録音もないため、定量値は追加せず、PronunciationはN/Aとする。
sessions.evidence_note: Connected an internal transfer, an external interview process, past workplace experience, and long-term career goals, reaching the practical conclusion to decide calmly once sufficient information is available. Hesitation, restarts, fragments, and unstable tense and word order appeared while discussing an emotionally difficult background, but the learner checked terms and intent and kept the main meaning clear. This single high-emotion conversation is not treated as a decline in ability, so the established L3 is retained. No comparable 60-second task or new directly assessed recording was available, so no quantitative metrics are added and pronunciation is N/A.

sessions.task: AI-era value creation and focused technical work
sessions.task_ja: AI時代の価値創造と集中が必要な技術作業
sessions.data_coverage: Realtime transcript excerpts; no comparable 60-second benchmark and no reliable direct audio analysis
sessions.evidence_quote: In the AI era, AI can handle simple tasks, but people need to focus on creating value.

sessions.evidence_note: Explained early-morning focused work, preparing an AI-ready development environment, contribution to the organization and personal growth, and human value creation in the AI era as one connected view. There were word searches and restarts, but the learner independently checked needed terms such as efficient, working hours, and the AI era, and promptly repaired interpretations that missed the intended point. No comparable 60-second task or new directly assessed recording was available, so the established five transcript-supported ratings are retained and pronunciation is N/A.

sessions.task: GPT-6 Astra technical reading, AI-autonomy discussion, and direct pronunciation review
sessions.task_ja: GPT-6 Astraの技術英文音読・AIの自律性に関する議論・直接発音評価
sessions.data_coverage: Full realtime conversation transcript covering article reading, clarification, summarization, and a sustained technical discussion, plus a direct 36.05-second read-aloud recording processed locally with waveform, pause, pitch, and ASR-based intelligibility evidence. The pronunciation passage differs from the standard 60-second benchmark, so pronunciation change is not inferred.
sessions.evidence_quote: If defining requirements is perfect, I can hand it off to AI ... setting checkpoints by a human is important in this AI era.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Spontaneous explanation in the realtime conversation; pauses and restarts lightly regularized.
sessions.evidence_note_ja: GPT-6 Astraの公式記事を音読し、内容を要約・確認しながら、AIの自律性、要件定義、人のチェックポイント、表面から見えないbackendリスクについて自分の立場を理由付きで議論した。誤解が生じた場面では記事を続けるよう明確に軌道修正し、autonomy、requirement、checkpointなどの専門語を確認して再利用した。停止・繰り返し・文法の揺れは残るためFluency・Lexical・GrammarはL3、結論と理由を展開したTask achievementと自発的に会話を修正したInteraction & repairはL4とする。本人も以前より英語がかなりスムーズに出る実感を報告しており、長い技術議論を維持した観察事実と合わせてL3内の流暢さの前進として記録する。36.05秒の直接音声は音割れなく、発話部分27.87秒、認識速度約123.6語/分、文章一致率94.1%だったため、Pronunciationは保守的にL3とする。標準60秒課題と異なるため、発音の過去差は判定しない。
sessions.evidence_note: Read the official GPT-6 Astra material and sustained a technical discussion about AI autonomy, requirements, human checkpoints, and hidden backend risks, giving reasons for a personal position. Explicitly redirected the conversation when it drifted and reused technical terms after checking them. Pauses, repetitions, word searches, and grammatical instability keep fluency, lexis, and grammar at L3; independently developing the conclusion and repairing the interaction support L4 for task achievement and interaction. The learner also reports that English is coming out much more smoothly, which is recorded as within-level fluency progress alongside the observed sustained discussion. A direct 36.05-second recording showed no clipping, 27.87 seconds of active speech, about 123.6 recognized words per minute, and a 94.1% word-match ratio, supporting a conservative L3 pronunciation rating. Because the passage differs from the standard 60-second task, no pronunciation change is inferred.

sessions.task: Final-interview reflection, consistent career motivation, and English-reading strategy
sessions.task_ja: 最終面接の振り返り・一貫したキャリア動機・英語読書戦略
sessions.data_coverage: Full realtime conversation transcript covering a sustained interview narrative, vocabulary clarification, interaction repair, topic change, and an English-reading discussion. No comparable 60-second benchmark and no dedicated recording was collected or directly analyzed, so pronunciation is not rated.
sessions.evidence_quote: I saw a connection between my university research and the company's role in energy infrastructure ... I had made up my mind.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Spontaneous final-interview reflection in the realtime conversation; pauses and restarts lightly regularized.
sessions.evidence_note_ja: 新卒時の会社選び、COVID-19 pandemicによる情報収集の制約、大学でのレーザー核融合研究、エネルギーインフラへの関心、現在の転職判断を一つの面接ストーリーとして説明した。後半は英語で小説を読む難しさを人物名と設定の負荷として具体化し、日本語版や映像を先に使う学習法を提案した。hesitation、restart、時制・語形の揺れは残るが、長い説明の目的を保ち、必要な語を確認し、直接の訳だけが欲しい場面では回答の粒度を明確に修正した。異なる二つの話題で同じ行動を再現したため、Task achievementとInteraction & repairはL4・強い、FluencyとLexicalはL3・強い、GrammarはL3・安定を維持する。専用録音を回収・直接分析していないためPronunciationはN/Aとし、Session 12の最終実測値を更新しない。
sessions.evidence_note: Connected the original company choice, limited information during the COVID-19 pandemic, university research in laser fusion, motivation toward energy infrastructure, and the current career decision into one sustained interview narrative. Later identified unfamiliar character names and settings as a specific obstacle in English fiction and proposed using a Japanese edition or adaptation as scaffolding. Hesitation, restarts, and unstable tense and word forms remain, but the learner maintained the purpose of long explanations, checked needed vocabulary, and explicitly repaired the response when only a direct translation was wanted. Reproducing these behaviors across two different topics supports retaining Task achievement and Interaction & repair at strong L4, Fluency and Lexical resource at strong L3, and Grammar control at established L3. No dedicated recording was collected or directly analyzed, so pronunciation is N/A and the last directly measured value from Session 12 is not updated.

sessions.task: GPT model cost and benchmark comparison, then English-fiction reading progress
sessions.task_ja: GPTモデルの費用・ベンチマーク比較と英語小説の読書進展
sessions.data_coverage: Realtime transcript segments covering the model comparison request, expansion to other companies, a return to English fiction, reading progress, and direct repair of the assistant's misunderstanding of the book title. No comparable 60-second benchmark or dedicated recording was collected or directly analyzed, so pronunciation is not rated.
sessions.evidence_quote: I want to know about ... comparison ... six with five-point-six cost and intelligence ... some other company's AI's benchmark is also.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Spontaneous model-comparison request in the realtime transcript; pauses retained as ellipses. The later reuse of 'the story starts to unfold from there' followed an assistant suggestion and is not counted as unprompted lexical production.
sessions.evidence_note_ja: GPT-6とGPT-5.6の費用と性能を比べたいと目的を示し、Astraが図にないことを指摘し、Terraと他社モデルまで対象を広げた。読書では、以前のSilent Paradeを約1年かけて読んだことと、現在のThe Keeper of the Camphor Treeを一日で40ページ読んだことを対比し、映像で物語を知っているため読みやすいと説明した。書名をChappyが誤解した際には繰り返して訂正した。この聞き違いを本人の発音ミスとは扱わない。語探しと言い直しが残るため、TaskとInteractionはL4・強い、FluencyとLexicalはL3・強い、GrammarはL3・安定を維持する。専用録音・比較可能な60秒課題はなくPronunciationはN/A。
sessions.evidence_note: Specified a comparison of GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 by cost and benchmark performance, noticed Astra was missing from the displayed chart, and expanded the comparison to Terra and other companies. In the reading discussion, contrasted taking about a year to finish Silent Parade with reading forty pages of The Keeper of the Camphor Tree in one day, and explained why a known film adaptation helped. Explicitly repaired the assistant's misunderstanding of the title; this is not pronunciation-error evidence. Word searches and restarts remain, so retain strong L4 for task achievement and interaction, strong L3 for fluency and lexical resource, and established L3 for grammar. No dedicated recording or comparable 60-second benchmark was completed, so pronunciation is N/A.

sessions.task: Career reflection and AWS-to-GCP IoT architecture comparison
sessions.task_ja: キャリアの振り返りとAWS・GCPのIoT設計比較
sessions.data_coverage: Realtime transcript segments covering the half-year review, career fit, familiar AWS services, GCP comparison, hypothetical IoT event design, and stakeholder priorities. No dedicated recording or comparable 60-second benchmark was directly analyzed.
sessions.evidence_quote: In my opinion, it depends on the service ... if we want to prioritize the speed ... if we want to prioritize the security or safety ... the stakeholders are different.
sessions.evidence_quote_origin: Spontaneous technical discussion in the realtime transcript; pauses and restarts lightly regularized. The cloud-service mapping and polished requirement sentence were assistant-proposed, not counted as spontaneous learner production.
sessions.evidence_note_ja: 半期の成果評価と長期的なキャリアの適合を説明した後、GCP比較を自分に馴染みのあるS3・DynamoDB・Lambda・Bedrockから始めるよう会話を修正した。IoTの仮想設計では、速度と追跡可能性の優先度がサービスと利害関係者で異なると述べ、設計前の要件定義へ結論を導いた。停止・言い直しと語探しは残るが、目的の維持と対話の修復は安定。前回と同じTaskとInteractionのL4・強い、FluencyとLexicalのL3・強い、GrammarのL3・安定を維持する。録音の直接分析がないためPronunciationはN/A。
sessions.evidence_note: Explained the half-year review and longer-term career fit, then redirected the GCP comparison toward familiar AWS services: S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and Bedrock. In a hypothetical IoT architecture discussion, distinguished speed from traceability for different stakeholders and concluded that requirements should be defined before design. Pauses, restarts, and word searches remain, but task focus and interaction repair were sustained. Retain the prior stages: strong L4 for task achievement and interaction, strong L3 for fluency and lexical resource, established L3 for grammar. Pronunciation is N/A because no recording was directly analyzed.

test_score_estimates.status: Non-official learning estimates, not standardized test results or guaranteed score conversions
test_score_estimates.evidence_boundary: The 2026-09-06 retrospective audit uses only the canonical Session 1-12 notes and preserved transcript evidence. Speaking and oral-interaction estimates are backfilled at Sessions 1, 3, and 7 as broad learning-reference milestones; unobserved sessions are not interpolated. Session 12 adds full-conversation evidence plus a directly processed 36.05-second read-aloud recording. Sessions 13-15 add realtime conversation evidence for narrative, technical comparison, reading strategy, requirements discussion, and interaction repair, but no new direct audio assessment. No standardized timed listening, reading, writing, or integrated-speaking task was completed.
test_score_estimates.history_policy: Retrospective milestone estimates are permitted only where the canonical record contains enough speaking or oral-interaction evidence. Do not create a point for every session or interpolate missing sessions. Keep user-reported actual results visually and structurally separate from estimates.

toefl_speaking.scale_note: The 1-6 scale introduced on January 21, 2026 is used. A legacy 0-30 comparison is display-only.
